title: Everyone should know SIMD
summary: Mitchell Hashimoto's article explains SIMD (Single Instruction Multiple Data), a CPU technique that processes multiple data elements simultaneously with one instruction, significantly improving performance for parallelizable tasks like image processing, data parsing, and scientific computations.
problem_solved: It addresses the inefficiency of sequential data processing by enabling parallel computation on a single CPU instruction.
why_valuable: Understanding SIMD helps developers write significantly faster code by leveraging modern CPU capabilities for parallel workloads.
